description: This file defines a PHP trait 'RoboTrait' within the 'SuiteCRM\Robo\Traits' namespace, providing reusable methods for Robo commands, including user prompts and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: askDefaultOptionWhenEmpty
methods.description: Prompts the user for input if the provided option is empty, setting a default value.

methods.name: chooseConfigOrDefault
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key, or returns a default fallback if the configuration or key is missing.
